s11.title: ORVIBO Integrated HVAC S350L specifications
note.1: *In summer, when cooling recovers enough heat, hot water counts as zero energy, leaving out the recovery pump: it draws 100 W, so 24 hours of running use 2.4 kWh. If your air conditioning does not recover enough heat, the unit heats water as a heat-pump water heater, which is not recovered heat. The hot water cost leaves out the zero-cold-water mode: with it on, the water left cooling in the pipes is heated again, which costs extra.
note.2: *Calculated for 120 m² of floor heating over a 3-month winter, against a grade 2 efficiency boiler under the Chinese standard GB 20665-2015, at time-of-use rates (¥0.85/kWh peak, ¥0.2/kWh off-peak). Real costs vary with insulation, habits, the local climate and electricity prices.
note.3: *Data from ORVIBO's lab. Actual savings vary with your habits, local electricity prices, the climate and the home's insulation.
note.4: *“Zero power bills” with direct solar drive: under ideal conditions, with ample sunlight and solar output that covers the unit's load, the system runs on solar power first and the main unit draws no grid power. Real-world running depends on the weather, the outdoor temperature, the home's insulation and the set temperature.
note.5: *The industry's highest standard: compared with brands in the industry, which usually give 3–⁠6 years of warranty.
note.6: *10-year warranty: the main unit (excluding parts) has a 10-year warranty, that is the standard 6 years plus a free 4-year extension, given only on orders placed during the promotion.
